prompt: Three-quarter view at chest height with a 35mm lens, in a burgundy mob lounge beside a small footlit stage. The singer fills the left foreground, his face a third of the frame high, turned slightly to the right, shouting with his jaw dropped, a cool teal light across his mouth. Further back and smaller, a slim woman drummer of about 35 with bobbed black hair and a tubby young Italian American trumpeter of about 25, trumpet lowered, shout with their heads back. Behind them the mirrored bar is bursting, bottles and glass hanging mid-air in teal and burgundy. No lettering, no black bars. Thanks.
